summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp (WLFC), via its wholly owned subsidiary Willis Dallas Ltd., filed an 8-K for a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire 100% of WNG II Aircraft Leasing (Cayman) Ltd. and WNG Aircraft Management 3, LLC, which hold a portfolio of 12 commercial aircraft and 13 spare engines. The total purchase price is $379.3 million, subject to adjustments for rent received, total losses, and interest at 6.25% p.a. from a historical economic closing date. Post-closing, WLFC will own the portfolio. The transaction involves a deposit and holdback; closing is subject to conditions. This acquisition expands WLFC's aircraft leasing portfolio. Watch for regulatory and financing conditions.
